verdict.rationale: Vercel Sandbox documents running commands in detached mode, which returns immediately, with log streaming. It is also positioned for agent workflows, with configurable and extendable timeouts and persistent sandboxes that resume state. Together these let agent work run in the background inside isolated microVMs. However, there is no documented way to set up automations within the product itself: no schedules, triggers, or recurring jobs, so the triggering would have to come from the user's own application or external orchestration. Missing for 10: native scheduling or trigger-based automation setup, long-running unattended execution beyond the 5-minute default timeout, and hands-on or independent corroboration of autonomous background operation.
